en: Tinted vintage postcard view of a large multi‑span steel truss bridge crossing a wide river, with brick piers and a monumental tower visible at the far end of the bridge. In the foreground a long river boat labeled "SAXONIA" travels along the water. The sky is lightly clouded and the colors are hand‑tinted in blue, green, and yellow tones. Printed captions on the image read "Riesa." in the upper center and "Elbbrücke." in the upper right.
